rules:
DECK. {deck_size} cards: {copies_per_rank} copies each of ranks {min_rank} to {max_rank}, plus {clear_cards} Clears (C). They are split into four stacks: Low (ranks 1-3, {low_stack_size} cards), Mid (ranks 4-6, {mid_stack_size} cards), High (ranks 7-9, {high_stack_size} cards) and Clear ({clear_stack_size} cards).

SETUP. The Low, Mid and High stacks are shuffled separately. In seat order 1, 2, 3, each seat's hand receives the top {cards_dealt_per_stack} Low, the top {cards_dealt_per_stack} Mid and the top {cards_dealt_per_stack} High cards, plus {clears_dealt_per_seat} Clear: {starting_hand_size} cards each. Every distinct set of {up_pile_size} cards from your hand is listed (ascending, C counting above 9). All seats pick one set at the same moment; a missing or invalid pick takes the first set listed. Those cards move to your public up pile, leaving {hand_after_up} in your secret hand. The pile starts empty (top rank {empty_top_rank}).

ROUND (at most {max_rounds}). Round increases by 1 and the lead seat is ((round - 1) mod 3) + 1, so rounds 1, 2, 3, 4 are led by seats 1, 2, 3, 1. Three turns follow: the lead seat, then the next, then the next (after seat 3 comes seat 1). A seat that is out skips its turn: it is asked nothing and nothing about it changes.

TURN. You play from your hand if it is not empty; otherwise from your up pile. Legal plays from that source only: a rank r with r >= top rank, as 1, 2 or 3 copies up to the number you hold ('RxK'); or a single C, which is always legal. When the top rank is 0, every card is legal. Plays are listed by rank, then copies, with C last. If no play is legal, your only option is PICK UP. A missing or invalid answer takes the first option listed. Every choice ends your turn.
- Rank play: the cards go onto the pile. If the top was already rank r, run count increases by the number played; otherwise run count becomes that number. Top rank becomes r. If run count reaches {run_wipe_threshold} or more, the pile is removed from the game, top rank becomes 0 and run count 0; if not, the pile stays.
- C: the C and the whole pile leave the game; top rank becomes 0 and run count 0.
- PICK UP: the whole pile goes into your hand, your picked_up count rises by 1, the pile is empty, top rank becomes 0 and run count 0.
After every turn your hand count, up count and cards left (hand + up) are recomputed; at 0 cards left you are out.

END. After a round's three turns, if at least one seat is out, game_over becomes true and the game ends, so every seat has had the same number of turns; otherwise play continues, until round {max_rounds} ends. The seats with the fewest cards left win: every seat with 0 cards shares the win if someone went out (two or three is a draw); after round {max_rounds} with nobody out, the fewest cards left wins and a tie for fewest is a draw. There is no draw pile and no face-down cards.
